title: Rocking the Spirit of Mammon
description: Get ready to have your mind and heart transformed as Pastor Chris Zehner challenges you to break free from the spirit of mammon and walk in the supernatural power of faith. In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris reveals the root cause of financial struggles and shows you how to release your faith and receive a breakthrough in your life. Join him as he rocks your world and equips you with the tools to operate in the opposite spirit and experience the blessings of God.
